images.name: 山间薄雾
images.prompt: Create one beautiful wide horizontal editorial photograph, aspect ratio 3:2, for a quiet personal daily newspaper web page. Scene: tranquil layers of rolling hills and a small lake in soft morning mist, a slender branch of leaves in the near foreground at far left, fine atmospheric depth. Restrained desaturated sage green, mist gray, muted sand, soft natural daylight, delicate analog film grain, sophisticated Japanese lifestyle magazine photography, believable natural detail, calm and spacious. All important elements in middle vertical 55% so it can crop gracefully to a wide newspaper banner. Gentle midtone exposure, avoid any large pure white or heavy black fields, no dramatic contrast, no typography, no logos, no border, no collage. This is the actual photographic asset, not a website screenshot or mockup.
